newsitem.title: USA: Indiana soybean, corn harvest near completion.
newsitem.headline: Indiana soybean, corn harvest near completion.

text.p: Indiana's soybean harvest pace advanced to 96 percent complete during the week ended Sunday, up from 92 percent the previous week, and many farmers were finished with corn harvest, according to the Indiana Agricultural Statistics Service.
Corn harvest stood at 78 percent complete, above the 65 percent a week ago but still behind 98 percent completed a year ago and 86 percent average.
Corn harvest remained about 11 days behind average.
Winter wheat emerged was rated 92 percent, up from 84 percent a week ago, but behind the 96 percent pace of a year ago as well as the 95 percent average pace.
Winter wheat condition slipped to seven percent excellent, 64 percent good, 25 percent fair and four percent poor.

Topsoil moisture levels were 15 percent surplus, 81 percent adequate and three percent short and one percent very short. Subsoil moisture was seven percent surplus, 84 percent adequate, six percent short and three percent very short.
